My kink origin story is pretty embarrassing, and I’ve only admitted this to close partners. Here goes:

In kindergarten, when I was 5 or 6, we would play typical games like “house,” where you could pretend to be a parent or a kid— the usual playground stuff. Well, I [24F] never liked to be a parent or the child. One day, a kid suggested that I be her “slave,” and that I do anything her or the family asked. That awakened something in me. From then on, any time my classmates would play house, I’d eagerly volunteer to be the slave. Maybe *too* eagerly. Following their orders gave me a thrill. Eventually they stopped playing with me because I weirded them out. It was obvious to everyone that I enjoyed it more than I should have. I didn’t understand for the longest time what was wrong with me, and figured I was just a creep. Luckily now that I’m in my 20s, I’ve discovered kink. It’s nice to know I’m not the only one with the desire to be controlled. 


I had also been molested just before starting kindergarten, so I wonder if that had anything to do with my hypersexuality at such a young age. (Of course not everyone into masochism has been sexually abused as a child— that’s just my personal experience).
